subject: Export failing on large report
body: Our largest monthly export is failing outright now, worked fine last month. Need this running today for a board deadline.

subject: Alert engine not triggering
body: Configured three new alerts this morning and none have fired despite clear threshold breaches in test data. Please check the engine, not just my config.

subject: Seat provisioning failed
body: Tried adding two new seats this morning, both stuck on pending for hours. Please push these through, we have people starting Monday.

subject: API returning 403 unexpectedly
body: Integration that's run fine for months is suddenly returning 403 on every call since this morning. Nothing changed our end.

subject: API latency spiking
body: API response times have tripled since yesterday afternoon, causing our internal jobs to time out. Please check server-side.

subject: Dashboards not loading for half our users
body: About half the team can't load any dashboard right now, the rest are fine. No obvious pattern in who's affected.

subject: Connector to ERP system down
body: Our ERP connector has been down since this morning, which is holding up our whole finance reporting cycle. Please prioritise.

subject: Deactivated accounts still active
body: Three accounts we deactivated last week are still able to log in. This needs fixing today, it's a compliance issue for us.

subject: Dashboard blank for the exec team
body: Executive dashboard is blank ahead of this afternoon's leadership meeting. Please treat as urgent, obviously.

subject: Same dashboard issue Sigrid just reported
body: Adding to Sigrid's ticket from an hour ago - I'm seeing the same blank dashboard on my end too, different browser, different login.

subject: Dashboard fine now but want root cause
body: Yesterday's blank dashboard issue is resolved but we'd like to understand what actually caused it before our next leadership meeting.

subject: Export permissions error
body: Getting a permissions error trying to export a report I've exported dozens of times before. Nothing changed on our side that I'm aware of.

subject: Alert recipients not receiving emails
body: Configured alert recipients aren't getting any emails, though the alert log shows they fired. Please check the email delivery side specifically.

subject: Export error again, different report
body: Same permissions error as Monday's ticket, this time on a different report. Might be worth checking whatever changed platform-wide rather than per-report.

subject: Report builder locked out mid-edit
body: Got locked out of a report I was actively editing, said someone else had it open - nobody else was in there.

subject: Bulk seat removal not working
body: Trying to remove five seats from a team that was restructured, the bulk action just spins and does nothing.

subject: ERP connector down again
body: Same ERP connector as last summer has gone down again. Please check if there's a recurring cause rather than treating each outage separately.

subject: Export timing out on schedule
body: Scheduled export has started timing out the last two runs, manual export still works fine. Please check the scheduled job specifically.

subject: Report builder crash on shared template
body: Shared quarterly template is crashing the builder for everyone who tries to open it. Please restore from backup if needed, we're on a deadline.

subject: Year-end export failing
body: Year-end consolidated export is failing at the final step every time, three attempts so far. Please treat as urgent given the date.

subject: Question about grouping by week in Report builder
body:
Hi, I'm trying to group a date field by ISO week number in the Report builder. I can see options for day, month, and quarter but not week. Is there a way to do this, or is it something on the roadmap? For now I've been using a workaround with a custom calculated field but it's not ideal.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: API rate limit documentation unclear
body:
We're integrating the API into a new internal tool and have a question about rate limits. The documentation mentions a limit per minute but doesn't specify whether it applies per API key, per workspace, or per endpoint. We hit a 429 yesterday in testing and want to understand the actual limits before we go to production.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: BigQuery connector sync failing since last week
body:
Our BigQuery connector stopped syncing successfully around 23 September. Jobs complete but the data isn't refreshing — the last successful data load is still showing as the 22nd. We've re-authenticated the connector and checked the service account permissions, which haven't changed. Getting a bit frustrated with this as several reports depend on it and people have been asking why the numbers aren't updating.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: Scheduled export not running — third week in a row
body:
I've now reported the scheduled export failure twice (see previous tickets) and the issue hasn't been resolved. The Monday morning export still isn't running. We got a workaround suggestion last time but that stopped working after two weeks. I need a proper fix, not a workaround. At this point my team is downloading reports manually every week, which is exactly what we bought this product to avoid.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: API breaking changes not communicated — pipeline is down
body:
Our data pipeline failed overnight. After investigation we found that the response schema on the /reports/data endpoint changed — a field was renamed without any notice in the changelog. This is not the first time something like this has happened. We rely on API stability for production systems and we need advance notice of breaking changes, full stop. I've also had the export scheduler issue open since October with no resolution. These things add up.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: Export scheduler — still broken
body:
Following up on the export scheduler issue that has been open, on and off, since October. The fix applied in December worked for about three weeks. It's broken again in the same way. I'd like to escalate this — can someone senior look at it?

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: Connector authentication token expiry
body:
The BigQuery connector is prompting for re-authentication again. I understand tokens expire but this seems to happen every few weeks, which is more frequent than expected. Is there a way to configure a longer-lived credential or service account flow that doesn't require manual re-auth? Just raising it — we'll re-authenticate in the meantime.

Jens Bergström, Head of Reporting

subject: Dashboard export resolution for board deck
body: We're preparing quarterly dashboards for inclusion directly in the board deck and the exported PNG images come out slightly blurred at the resolution we need for print. Is there a way to export dashboards at a higher DPI, or a recommended workflow for getting print-quality output rather than screen resolution? Would be good to get this sorted before our next board cycle in October.

subject: API pagination issue on large report pulls
body: It's been a while since we last wrote in - we're now pulling larger historical datasets via the API for a year-end review and running into pagination that seems to cap out around 5,000 rows per call regardless of the page size parameter we set. For datasets larger than that we've ended up assembling the results into Excel in batches, which is workable but slow. Could you confirm the actual pagination limits and whether there's a more efficient method for bulk historical pulls?

subject: Alert digest still bundling unrelated metrics
body: Following up two weeks after the API pagination question - separately, the weekly alert digest continues to bundle unrelated KPIs into a single email regardless of the subscription groups we've set up, something we first flagged the better part of a year ago. We've since set up a simpler manual check each Monday in Excel rather than rely on the digest for anything time-sensitive, so there's no pressure to prioritise this above the pagination point. Just wanted it on file in case it's useful context.

subject: Connector configuration for new source
body: Setting up a connector to a new internal database and want to confirm the supported authentication methods before we start.

subject: Seat license question
body: Quick question on whether unused seats roll over or if we lose them if we don't reassign before the renewal date.

subject: Alert configuration for multiple recipients
body: Trying to set one alert to notify three different people with different thresholds each - not sure if that's possible in the current setup or if we need three separate alerts.

subject: Report builder template question
body: Is there a way to duplicate an existing report template as a starting point for a new one, rather than building from a blank canvas each time?

subject: Template duplication working well
body: Following up on the template duplication question from last month - it's working well, saved us a fair amount of setup time on the new regional reports.

subject: Report builder formula question
body: Trying to add a calculated field that references two different data sources in one report - is that supported, or does it need to be done upstream?

subject: Dashboard refresh schedule question
body: Can the dashboard refresh schedule be set differently for different tiles, or is it one schedule for the whole dashboard?

subject: API sync errors piling up
body: We're getting a growing number of failed sync jobs through the API over the past week, and the error messages aren't telling us much. Would like this looked at properly, not just patched.

subject: Connector dropping mid-sync
body: Now the data connector itself is dropping partway through syncs, roughly every other run. Combined with the API errors from two weeks ago, it's starting to feel like something underlying isn't stable.

subject: Connector issue back, unresolved from November
body: The connector dropout from November is back, worse than before - three failed syncs today alone. We flagged this six weeks ago and it doesn't feel like it's actually been fixed, just quiet for a while.

subject: API down over the new year, no word from anyone
body: The API was unreliable through most of the holiday period and we heard nothing despite the connector issue we raised in December still being open. This is the third related ticket since November.

subject: Still no resolution on API reliability
body: Three weeks since my last message on this and the API is still dropping calls randomly. We are now manually re-running our morning refresh most days, which defeats the point of automating it.

subject: Connector broken again - this needs a real fix, not a patch
body: Connector failed overnight again. This is now the fourth ticket on connector or API instability since November and each time it gets patched rather than actually fixed. I need someone senior to look at the underlying cause, not another workaround.

subject: Escalating - connector issues unresolved since November
body: I'd like this formally escalated. We've now had five months of intermittent connector and API failures, multiple tickets, and no clear explanation of root cause. I need to speak to someone who can commit to a fix and a timeline, not just the next available support agent.

subject: Following up on the escalation from March
body: Appreciate the call last week following my escalation, but the connector went down again this weekend. I understand root cause work is underway - please keep sending updates even if there's nothing new, silence is what got us here.

subject: Report builder issue - still feeling cautious after this year
body: Separate from the connector work, the report builder is now throwing errors on save. Given everything else this year I'd like confirmation this is being taken seriously and not queued behind other things.

subject: Connector stable for a full month - thank you
body: Wanted to follow up properly rather than just going quiet: the connector has held steady for a full month since the engineering call in July. Whatever changed on your end, thank you - it's the longest stable stretch we've had since last November.

subject: Report builder fix from August holding up
body: The report builder fix from a couple of weeks ago is holding up well. Genuinely appreciate the team staying on this through what was a difficult few months for us.

subject: Minor API question, nothing urgent
body: Small one - noticed a slight delay on API responses this week, nothing like the issues from earlier in the year, just flagging in case it's useful data for you. No rush on this one.

subject: Seat request for new team member
body: Nothing dramatic this time - just need a new seat provisioned for someone joining next week. Thanks again for how things have been running lately.

subject: Small report builder question
body: Wondering if there's a way to set a default template for a specific team rather than the whole account. Not urgent, just tidying things up.

subject: Export scheduling question
body: Would like to move one of our exports to a different time of day - can we do that ourselves in settings or does support need to change it?

subject: New connector for a small side project
body: Setting up a connector for a smaller internal project, nothing to do with the finance systems from earlier this year. Should be straightforward on our end.

subject: Report builder formatting question
body: Trying to get consistent header formatting across a set of reports - is there a shared style option or do we set each one individually?

subject: Alert threshold tuning
body: A couple of our alert thresholds are firing more often than useful now that our numbers have grown - could use some help retuning them for current volumes.

subject: API access for a new analyst
body: New analyst starting next week will need API access at a read-only level. Can you point me to the right process?

subject: Report builder - can't get consolidated view to work
body: Trying to build a consolidated report across our three subsidiaries and can't get the builder to merge the data sources correctly. Might just be something we're missing in the setup - any guidance appreciated.

subject: Connector for subsidiary ledger system
body: Following on from Ville's report builder question, we think part of the issue is that one subsidiary's ledger system isn't connected yet. Can you confirm if it's a supported connector type?

subject: Export currency formatting
body: Exports are coming out with our base currency symbol even for subsidiary reports that should show local currency. Small thing but throws off the numbers at a glance.

subject: Connector setup — connecting to on-premise database
body:
We're trying to set up a connector to an on-premise SQL Server database. The database is behind a firewall. I've read about an IP allowlist approach — can you confirm the IP ranges we need to whitelist, and whether there's an agent or proxy option for on-premise connections?

Matti Mäkinen, Operations Lead

subject: Export timezone — dates showing in UTC instead of local
body:
Our scheduled exports show date/time values in UTC. We need them in local time (CET/CEST). Is there a per-export timezone setting, or is it taken from the workspace-level setting? I've set the workspace timezone to Helsinki but the exports haven't changed.

Matti Mäkinen, Operations Lead

subject: Connector failing after database migration
body:
We migrated our database to a new host last week. Updated the connector hostname and credentials but it's not connecting — timeout error. The database is accessible from our network, so it's likely a firewall/IP issue. Could you confirm whether your connector IP ranges have changed recently? We'll update our allowlist.

Matti Mäkinen, Operations Lead

subject: Setting up a multi-condition alert
body:
I'd like to set up an alert that triggers only when two conditions are both true simultaneously (e.g. metric A is above threshold AND metric B is below threshold). Is AND logic between conditions supported in the alert builder? I can only find single-condition alerts in the interface.

Matti Mäkinen, Operations Lead

subject: Scheduled export came through blank
body: This morning's scheduled export to the board pack template was completely empty again - no data, just headers. Can someone look at this today, please, I need it before Wednesday's meeting.

subject: Export broke again - three days later
body: We're back here again. The export dropped the pivot section overnight, same as last week. I'd like to understand what's actually causing this rather than another quick patch.

subject: Exports cutting off columns
body: PDF exports have been cutting off the last two columns of every report since Tuesday. This is the third export issue since the summer - can we get a proper root cause this time?

subject: API calls failing since this morning
body: Our nightly API pull has failed for two nights running with a 500 error. Nothing changed on our end. Please treat this as urgent, the finance team is waiting on the numbers.

subject: Report builder crashing on save
body: Now the report builder is throwing an error every time I try to save a template. Combined with yesterday's API failure this is turning into a bad week - can we get eyes on both?

subject: Connector to our warehouse dropped
body: Add the warehouse connector to the list - it's shown 'disconnected' since this morning. Three things broken in two days is not normal for us.

subject: Alerts not firing - fourth issue this week
body: None of our threshold alerts fired overnight despite the numbers being well past trigger level. At this point I'd like a call, not just a ticket queue.

subject: API errors again
body: Same API failure as November - 500 errors on the nightly pull. Please check whether whatever caused that has come back.

subject: API still unstable
body: Second API failure in four days. I need this stable before month-end close, not after.

subject: Connector sync failed overnight
body: Warehouse connector failed again overnight, same symptom as November. Can we get a permanent fix instead of a restart each time?

subject: Can't add new team member - seat error
body: Trying to add a new analyst and the seat allocation screen just errors out. We're paying for the seat, it should work.

subject: Question about API rate limits
body: We're planning to increase our API polling frequency for the treasury dashboard. Could you confirm the current rate limit for the Professional plan and whether it can be raised?

subject: Connector setup - NetSuite general ledger
body: We're setting up a new connector to pull general ledger data from NetSuite and want to confirm the recommended sync frequency for a dataset this size, roughly 40,000 rows growing daily. Also, does the connector support incremental syncs, or does each run pull the full table? Trying to plan around our own system's API limits before we switch this on for production reporting.

subject: NetSuite connector - initial sync stuck at 60%
body: Following up quickly - we went ahead and enabled the connector from Tuesday's ticket, but the initial full sync has been stuck at roughly 60% progress for over 24 hours with no error message. We've tried pausing and restarting it twice. Given we need this live before month-end, could someone take a look today if possible?

subject: Alerts silent since the connector went live
body: Coming back to this after a quiet few months - since the NetSuite connector finally synced properly in January, none of our threshold alerts tied to GL data have fired at all, even during a month where we know we breached two budget thresholds. We've gone back to checking the numbers manually in Excel each week because we can't trust the alerts to catch anything. This has real consequences if something material slips through unnoticed, so we'd like this looked at properly rather than patched over.

subject: Dashboard rendering incomplete GL data
body: Separate issue this time - the operations dashboard is now excluding the most recent two weeks of GL entries from its rolling 90-day view, so the trend lines look artificially flat at the end. We've cross-checked the raw numbers in Excel and they're correct there, so it looks like a dashboard-side filtering issue rather than a data problem. Not blocking day to day since we're used to checking the underlying figures separately at this point, but wanted to flag it.

subject: Seat renewal - scaling back before contract review
body: As we head into our contract renewal discussion, we'd like to reduce our seat count from twelve to eight - a few of the team have moved most of their regular reporting into Excel given the alert and dashboard issues from earlier this year, so the extra seats haven't been used much lately. Could you send over what the process looks like for adjusting seat numbers at renewal? No urgency on timing, just want it in place before the next billing cycle.

subject: Alert threshold not saving
body: When I set a new alert threshold on the revenue dashboard it reverts to the default value after refresh. Can you check the configuration on our account?

subject: Adding a new data source
body: We'd like to connect our new CRM export to Kataja. Is there a standard connector for HubSpot, or do we need to go through the generic CSV import?

subject: Dashboard sharing with external auditor
body: Our auditor needs read-only access to two dashboards for the year-end review but isn't part of our organisation. What's the recommended way to share externally?

subject: Formula error in report builder
body: One of our custom formulas in the report builder is returning #ERROR since last week's update, though nothing changed on our side. Could you take a look?

subject: Report builder - grouping question
body: Is there a way to group rows by quarter rather than month in the report builder without rebuilding the whole report? Would save us some time each close.

subject: Dashboard loading very slowly
body: Our main dashboard has been taking over a minute to load for the past week, sometimes timing out completely. It's making the morning check-in painful. Can you look into it?

subject: Export timing out
body: Following up from Liisa's dashboard ticket - our exports are now timing out too. Feels connected. Please escalate if it isn't a quick fix.

subject: API integration down for a week
body: Our API integration with the ERP has been failing since before Christmas and nobody has given us a clear answer. This is the second performance issue this year and it's taking too long to hear back.

subject: Exports still broken - going on two weeks
body: The export problem from December never actually went away, it just got quieter. Now it's back and worse. Twenty-five days to fix something like this is not acceptable for a Standard-tier account that pays on time.

subject: Escalating - report builder unusable since Monday
body: I need this escalated past first-line support. The report builder has been unusable since Monday and this is the third serious outage in seven months. We are reviewing whether Kataja can support our reporting cycle at all if this continues.

subject: Escalation - exports failing again, need a call
body: Adding to Liisa's escalation: exports are down too. We'd like a call with someone senior this week, not another ticket update. Our board pack is due Friday.

subject: Seat adjustment after the recent outages
body: Thank you to the team that got on the call last week - the fixes have held. Separately, could you adjust our seat count down by one, we had a role change.

subject: Dashboard performance - checking in
body: Dashboards have been fast and stable since the fixes went in. Small thing: could the currency default be set to EUR for all users rather than per-login?

subject: Report builder - quick question
body: Things have been running smoothly since the summer. Quick one - is there a way to duplicate a report template across workspaces?

subject: New dashboard widget request
body: Really pleased with how stable things have been the last month. Any chance of adding a rolling 12-month widget type to the dashboard builder?

subject: Export scheduling for year-end
body: Setting up our year-end export schedule - could you confirm the maximum file size for a single scheduled export? Want to plan ahead this time.

subject: API access for new BI hire
body: We're onboarding a new BI analyst who'll need API credentials. Could you send over the standard process?

subject: New connector for payroll system
body: Could you tell us whether there's a native connector for Netvisor, or if we'd need to build it via the generic API? Planning next year's integrations.

subject: Report builder - conditional formatting question
body: Is it possible to apply conditional formatting to a calculated column in the report builder, or only to raw data columns? Couldn't find it in the help docs.

subject: Dashboard filter not persisting
body: When I set a filter on the operations dashboard and log out, it resets by the next morning. Is that expected behaviour or a bug?

subject: Adding a second dashboard view
body: We'd like to set up a second dashboard view for the ops team with a narrower set of KPIs. Is that included in our current plan or does it need an add-on?

subject: Nested report sections
body: Trying to build a report with nested sub-reports by region and then by product line. Is that supported in the current report builder, or would we need separate reports stitched together?

subject: Seat management - comparing to Storsund BI
body: We evaluated Storsund BI briefly last year and one thing that stood out was their bulk seat import via CSV. Does Kataja have an equivalent, or do seats need to be added one at a time?

subject: Report builder - variable reuse
body: Can a calculated variable defined in one report section be reused in another section of the same report, or does it need to be redefined each time?

subject: Report builder template question
body: Following up on Pekka's question from April - we've now got the variable reuse working, thanks. Separately, is there a way to lock a template so junior analysts can't edit the layout?

subject: Export formatting for external partners
body: We share exports with an external partner who needs a specific column order that differs from our internal reports. Is there a way to save a second export profile for the same report?

subject: Connector refresh frequency
body: Can we change our warehouse connector to refresh every hour instead of every four hours? Wasn't obvious where to set that.

subject: Dashboard tile resizing
body: Is there a way to resize individual tiles on a dashboard, or are they fixed to the grid layout?

subject: Scheduled export recipients
body: How many email recipients can a single scheduled export be sent to? We want to add two more people to our weekly report.

subject: Dashboard colour theme
body: Can the dashboard colour theme be changed per workspace, or is it account-wide only?

subject: Report builder - date range presets
body: Is it possible to add a custom date range preset (e.g. 'last fiscal quarter') to the report builder's date picker?

subject: Export file naming
body: Our scheduled exports all download with the same generic filename. Can the filename include the report name and date automatically?

subject: Export job failed - no error message
body: The nightly export job failed silently again last night, no error, no file. This is affecting our morning reporting. Please look into it urgently.

subject: Also - seat count wrong on billing page
body: While we're at it, our seat count on the billing page shows two more than we actually have active. Can someone reconcile that too?

subject: Seat count still wrong
body: Checked again this morning and the seat discrepancy from yesterday hasn't been corrected. Please confirm when this'll be fixed.

subject: Report builder freezing on large dataset
body: The report builder is freezing whenever I pull in more than about 50k rows. Given the export issue this week too, it's been a rough few days on our end.

subject: API timeout on large pulls
body: Same symptom as the report builder issue I just logged - our API calls are timing out on large pulls. Feels like it might be the same root cause.

subject: Dashboard showing stale data
body: Our main dashboard hasn't refreshed since yesterday afternoon despite the connector showing as synced. Numbers are stale for this morning's standup.

subject: Dashboard issue back again
body: Same stale-data issue as yesterday, different dashboard this time. Can we get a proper fix rather than a one-off refresh?

subject: API returning 502 errors
body: API endpoint has been returning intermittent 502s since this morning. Our integration retries but it's clogging up our logs.

subject: Exports failing again - one day after API issue
body: Exports are down now too, right after yesterday's API problem. Please confirm whether these are related.

subject: Dashboard load errors continuing
body: Dashboards are throwing load errors intermittently again. Third dashboard issue since January.

subject: Export job failed overnight
body: Overnight export failed again, same silent-failure pattern as back in October. Please check the job logs.
